content_of_post_to_answer: Is “Mind” the Source of all apparent “Separation”? Is “Mind” itself thus the Generator of “Maya”?
answer: The mind may not create separation itself; it creates the framework through which separation is perceived. Distinctions like self/other, subject/object, and mine/yours are useful for navigating life, but suffering begins when these mental boundaries are mistaken for absolute reality. Maya may not be an illusion of nothingness, but the mistake of confusing our interpretations with what is actually present. The mind is not the enemy; unconscious identification with it is.
